editions.title: Last week in motorsport
editions.intro: A look back at the racing action from 22 to 28 September, covering rounds across Formula 1, Formula 2, NASCAR Cup Series, NHRA Drag Racing and the World Endurance Championship.

items.headline: Azerbaijan Grand Prix
items.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sat 26 Sep
items.body: George Russell of Mercedes won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix at Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan, followed by Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar for Red Bull.

items.headline: Baku
items.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sun 27 Sep
items.body: Formula 2 arrived in Baku on Sunday 27 September.

items.headline: Hollywood Casino 400
items.body: The NASCAR Cup Series visited Kansas Speedway for the Hollywood Casino 400 on Sunday 27 September.

items.headline: Nationals at The Rock
items.detail: Rockingham Dragway, North Carolina · Sun 27 Sep
items.body: NHRA Drag Racing held the Nationals at The Rock at Rockingham Dragway, North Carolina, on Sunday 27 September.

items.headline: 6 Hours of Fuji
items.body: Round seven of the World Endurance Championship took place at Fuji Speedway, Japan, for the 6 Hours of Fuji on Sunday 27 September.
